label: Highlight Clips
description: Pick a video, mark one or more time ranges, and get each range as its own clip — mp4 or webm, audio intact, one render for the whole batch.

sourceId.label: Source
sourceId.description: The video to pull highlight clips from.

ranges.label: Highlight ranges
ranges.description: Highlight ranges within the source video, milliseconds. Each { startMs, endMs, label? } entry becomes its own output clip; label (optional) feeds the output filename.

outputFormat.label: Format
outputFormat.description: Container for every emitted clip: "mp4" (default) or "webm".

maxWidth.label: Max width (px)
maxWidth.description: Optional output width cap in pixels — clips wider than this downscale (aspect-preserved, even-rounded). Never upscales.

muteAudio.label: Mute audio
muteAudio.description: Strip the audio track from the clips. Off by default — audio passes through.
